quest.title: All the World's a Stage
quest.description: Drama is both the generalized form and essence of reality. Just what kind of light does the story onstage reflect in his eyes?

dialogues.speaker: Qabus
dialogues.text: Where in the seven nations is that little twerp? The next scene is about to begin...

dialogues.speaker: Gundafar
dialogues.text: God only knows. It's not the first time he's done this, either... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Qabus
dialogues.text: You dare to defy your orders and abandon the front?

dialogues.speaker: Gundafar
dialogues.text: I return to Your Majesty's palace to deliver a letter from the front, penned by the Prince himself. Your humble servant Gundafar respectfully begs an audience.

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: Hmm... I wonder if I should go strike up a conversation with him?

dialogues.speaker: Oguz
dialogues.text: The show is pretty good. Are you guys professional?

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: If you want to order any food, just holler.

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: Your food's on the way. It'll just be a few more minutes.

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: Just give me a shout if you need anything else.

dialogues.speaker: Qabus
dialogues.text: You dare to defy your orders and abandon the front?

dialogues.speaker: Gundafar
dialogues.text: I return to Your Majesty's palace to deliver a letter from the front, penned by the Prince himself. Your humble servant Gundafar respectfully begs an audience.

dialogues.speaker: Performance Bulletin
dialogues.text: The Qabus Theatre is in town. Buy a drink and enjoy the performance for free!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: There are worse ways to pass the time than watching a little outdoor theater... Too bad I already know the story.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #Having {NICKNAME} here will help to keep things interesting, though. And being close to where the action's happening is always exciting.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: So must it be... Hahaha, yes, so must it be!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I always like to extricate myself before things start getting tedious.

dialogues.speaker: Qabus
dialogues.text: No matter how you look at it, life as an actor is more stable than life as a mercenary.

dialogues.speaker: Gundafar
dialogues.text: Good heavens, these lines are a bit much. Who talks like this in real life? Guess this is the wisdom of the Akademiya in action...

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: That outlander sure is easy on the eyes...

dialogues.speaker: Roshana
dialogues.text: Huh, so he's from Mondstadt? I could have sworn he was a desert-dweller...

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: It's too bad that Darbil's troupe is always on the move. I wish they could stay here for longer.

dialogues.speaker: Oguz
dialogues.text: Can't tell if this counts as me slacking off during work... It's a gray area, for sure.
